title: An enthalpy level diagram
caption: Neutralisation: H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l), ΔH = −57.1 kJ mol⁻¹. The products sit below the reactants on the enthalpy scale and the arrow points down: exothermic.
alt: Two levels: H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) above, H₂O(l) below, with a downward arrow labelled ΔH = −57.1 kJ mol⁻¹.
